The background consists of green trees and foliage in soft, natural daylight. (2) The camera pans to a large, intricate metal sculpture standing on a gravel path. The sculpture is made of rusted metal plates cut into the shapes of various creatures. It is surrounded by a circle of red bricks and stones. (3) A close-up shot shows a stack of split firewood resting against a large, rectangular stone bench in a park setting. Green grass and fallen leaves are visible on the ground. (4) The camera circles the metal sculpture, showing its three-dimensional structure from different angles. The background includes park benches, trees, and a small gazebo in the distance. (5) Detailed close-up shots highlight specific features of the sculpture, including cutout eyes and jagged silhouettes resembling a demon, a dragon, and a bull-like figure. (6) The man's hand, wearing a beaded bracelet, enters the lower frame and performs a snapping motion towards the sculpture. (7) The scene transitions instantly to night. The sculpture is now engulfed in a bright, roaring fire. The orange flames dance through the metal cutouts against the pitch-black background.
